name: HackByte CTF 2025
tagline: 48-hour capture-the-flag competition — Web, Crypto, Pwn & OSINT
description: HackByte is TheDarkNet Community's flagship 48-hour CTF. Teams of 1–5 compete across Web Exploitation, Binary Pwn, Cryptography, Forensics, and OSINT challenges crafted by veteran security researchers. Cash prizes, swag, and internship opportunities await top performers.

program.title: Opening Ceremony & Rules Briefing
program.description: Welcome address and challenge platform reveal.

name: Web Exploitation Masterclass
tagline: Hands-on workshop covering OWASP Top 10 and beyond
description: A full-day hands-on workshop designed for beginners and intermediate practitioners. Covers SQL Injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, Authentication Bypass, and business logic flaws using a custom vulnerable web app environment.

name: OSINT & Threat Intelligence Summit
tagline: Open-source intelligence gathering for cybersecurity professionals
description: A two-day summit focused on open-source intelligence methodologies, threat actor profiling, and cyber threat intelligence for defensive and offensive security practitioners.

name: Binary Exploitation Bootcamp
tagline: Buffer overflows, ROP chains, and shellcode from scratch
description: Three-day intensive bootcamp covering low-level binary exploitation — stack smashing, heap exploitation, ROP chain construction, ASLR/NX bypass, and kernel-level attacks.

name: Network Security Hackathon
tagline: Build security tools and network defence solutions in 24 hours
description: A 24-hour hackathon where teams build network intrusion detection tools, firewall configurations, packet analysers, or automated threat response systems.

name: Malware Analysis Workshop
tagline: Static and dynamic analysis of real-world malware samples
description: A hands-on session with sandboxed real-world malware samples. Learn static analysis with IDA Free/Ghidra and dynamic analysis with Cuckoo Sandbox.
